# id: # Fletching methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Headless arrows (feathers onto arrow shafts)
where: Anywhere; the stackable materials suit questing, Agility or running (IM guide)
note: 1 xp per headless arrow and about 45,000 per hour at 3,000 actions; feathers are 2 coins each in feather packs and arrow shafts 6 coins each at Dargaud's (Ranged 40) or cut from logs at 1/3 xp each; per-hour item counts are our estimate (one feather and one shaft per arrow); membership not stated
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Fletching, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching 2026-11-11

name: Metal arrows (bronze to mithril arrowtips)
where: Arrowtips from shops (Hickton's Archery Emporium in Catherby per UIM guide); headless arrows from the row above
note: 15 arrows per action; xp/h 58,500, 112,500, 225,000 and 337,500 per the IM table; about 45,000 arrows per hour per the IM guide; per-hour item counts are our estimate; shop arrowtip prices rise with stock; membership not stated

name: Iron darts (smithed iron dart tips)
where: Anywhere; smith iron bars into iron dart tips
note: 3.8 xp per iron dart; about 18,000 darts per hour (3 sets of 10 per tick) and 68,000+ xp/h per the IM guide; per-hour item counts are our estimate; the smithing level for iron dart tips is not stated; membership not stated
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Fletching, Fletching training 2026-11-11

name: Vale Totems (building totems with unstrung bows)
where: Auburnvale totem loop in Auburn Valley (eight totem sites)
note: Requires the Vale Totems miniquest (enum not verified, so -); standard max-efficiency rates from the IM summary (oak 22,500, willow 55,000, maple 87,500; yew 140,000 and magic 265,000 have no level given); levels are the bow levels on the Fletching training page (oak shortbow 20, willow shortbow 35, maple longbow 55); UIM says noted yew longbows give well over 100,000 casually; the fletching knife cuts bow time from 3 to 2 ticks and the log basket boosts rates; membership not stated
source: OSRS Wiki Fletching training, Ironman Guide/Fletching, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching 2026-11-11

name: Broad arrows
where: Anywhere with downtime, such as Hallowed Sepulchre Agility, herbiboar tracking or Arceuus runes (IM guide)
note: Needs Broader Fletching (300 Slayer reward points); each broad arrow gives 11 xp including its headless arrow; 450,000 xp/h with bought headless arrows and broad arrowheads per the IM table, vs 247,500 with arrow shafts, feathers and broad arrowheads; about 5.7-5.9 coins per xp; per-hour item counts are our estimate from 450,000 divided by 10 xp; membership flagged, not stated
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Fletching, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching 2026-11-11

name: Maple longbows (u) from Miscellania maple logs
where: Miscellania (maple logs at 56.10 each per the IM guide)
note: About 100,000 xp/h, or about 150,000 with a fletching knife, per the IM guide; per-hour counts not stated; the IM guide says stringing these into maple longbows is not recommended for ironmen; membership not stated

name: Redwood shields
where: Anywhere; fletch excess redwood logs from Woodcutting
note: 216 xp per shield from 2 redwood logs (108 xp per log); the IM guide says over 150,000 xp/h, with 150000 used as the floor; per-hour counts are our estimate (150,000 divided by 108 and by 216)

name: Bruma kindling at Wintertodt
note: Fletching a bruma root gives 0.6 x Fletching level xp (IM and UIM guides); the page says 350-370 kindling per hour, and 350 (low end) is used as our per-hour estimate; the 99 row was cut off in the source; the IM guide says not a primary method below about level 20; membership flagged, not stated
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Fletching, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching 2026-11-11
